nodes.question: What was the objective of the study conducted in Yueli Village, Wenchuan County, Aba Prefecture?
nodes.answer: The objective of the study was to evaluate the indoor environment of traditional houses by assessing residents' thermal comfort and environmental conditions.

nodes.question: What factors did the study by Wang et al. aim to optimize during the design phase of residential buildings in China?
